author: Cleo Abram
description:
The violent boiling outer layer we can see is constantly moving the deeper parts of the sun with pressure waves… or sound.

THE SUN IS MAKING MUSIC. But we can’t hear it with the vacuum of space between us!

So scientists found an incredible way to measure the jiggling, like carefully watching a drum to see what it’s playing, and what they found was wild!

To see that, subscribe! 

#sun #space #sound #music #science
title: How Do We Know What's Inside the Sun?
